paraphrase_selection_protocol: Pre-declared 6-case held-out paraphrase suite selected prior to held-out execution along orthogonal variation axes: (H1) forward shift +3 crossing Sunday->Tuesday boundary, (H2) forward shift with missing anchor in paraphrased wording ('tres jornadas más tarde'), (H3) backward shift with competing anchor ('Ayer era miércoles' vs 'lanzamiento oficial ocurrió el lunes') crossing week boundary to Saturday, (H4) refuted variant of H3 where distractor anchor minus 2 yields claimed Monday, (H5) refuted backward shift on Monday ('hoy es lunes' -> expected Saturday vs claimed Friday), and (H6) non-temporal cross-document USD margin subtraction (2,400 - 1,650 = 750 unseen in sources).
